title: Magellan: Guided MCTS for Latent Space Exploration and Novelty Generation

contributions.purpose: 将 LLM 生成重构为潜在概念空间的引导式探索
contributions.mechanism: 推理时 Monte Carlo Tree Search(MCTS)框架,节点为叙事片段,路径为完整推理线
contributions.evaluation: 最大 30 迭代但均值仅约 3 次收敛;Qwen3-1.7B 骨干,4 节点 V100、约 36h
contributions.source_quote: We propose Magellan, a novel framework that applies Monte Carlo Tree Search at inference-time, reframing LLM generation from passive sequence prediction into an active, guided exploration within the model's latent space.

contributions.purpose: 用原则性引导替代不可靠的自评估
contributions.mechanism: 分层引导:正交投影构造“语义罗盘”vtarget=vp+α·vm′(全局)+ landscape-aware 多目标值函数 V=wcoh·Vcoh+wnov·Vnov+wprog·Vprog(局部,增广 UCT)
contributions.evaluation: 消融显示两者均关键(见 C3)
contributions.source_quote: a hierarchical guidance mechanism that combines a long-range 'semantic compass' (vtarget) for global goal-setting with a principled, multi-objective value function

contributions.mechanism: LLM-as-Judge(DeepSeek-V3.1)对 50 themes 打分 + 强制选择 Win Rate;含消融
contributions.evaluation: Overall 8.94、Win 92%、Innovation 8.54、Plausibility 8.98,而 ReAct 4.56/ToT 4.93 崩溃;消融:去引导 Win 90→10%、去 novelty →2%
contributions.source_quote: Magellan significantly outperforms strong baselines, including ReAct and ToT, in generating scientific ideas with superior plausibility and innovation

self_declared_provenance.quote: Frameworks like Tree of Thoughts (ToT) ... critically falter on their evaluation mechanism. They typically rely on the LLM to self-evaluate ... To provide the principled, explicit evaluation mechanism missing from prior work, we introduce Magellan
By integrating MCTS with a principled, multi-objective value function, Magellan moves beyond simple diversification to perform a strategic, goal-directed search

notes: 唯一 accept。trade-off(带数字):计算成本更高——Magellan 5548.5s/209,445 tokens vs ToT 3563.5s/187,174、ReAct 1024.3s/14,478;CoT 在 Clarity 略胜(9.48 vs 9.30);Qwen-0.6B 完全失败(Win 0%)、4B 达 88%——依赖大骨干。质量/一致性问题:Magellan(Full) Win Rate 跨表不一(Table1 92% / Table4 90% / Table5 98% / Table6 1.7B 12%),因各表对手不同(win rate 相对),论文有说明但易误读;单一 LLM 评委、自选 50 themes、骨干仅 1.7B,ToT/ReAct 分数崩到 4.x 疑基线未充分调优;Vnov/prog 理论范围[0,2] 未归一化(脚注承认留 future work)。署名含 'Gemini / Google / gemini.google.com' 作为共同作者(AI 署名),提供真实 GitHub repo。checklist AI:Hypothesis[D]、design[C]、analysis[C]、writing[C]。四元组以论文 threefold 自声明列表为准。
